desc:
🦷 Become A Dentist! 🦷
Patients are lining up and their teeth are a MESS. Grab your tools and fix them... or make it hilariously worse!

🔧 Drill, forceps, X-ray, floss, laughing gas and lots more tools
😬 Cavities, rotten teeth, cracks, stains and wobbly baby teeth
🏴‍☠️ Special patients: a pirate with a gold tooth, a vampire, a shark and even a dog!
🤝 Team Clinic: invite a friend and work on the same mouth together
📅 Daily Mouth: one patient for everyone, with a top score board and a "Most problems caused" board
⭐ Level up from Intern all the way to LEGENDARY DENTIST
🛒 Upgrade your tools, unlock tool skins and decorate your clinic

Be gentle... or don't. Your patient will let you know! 😂

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite the game to help us add more patients and tools!
🎁 Join the Third Eye Studios group for a FREE reward! Claim it at the sign in your clinic.
